title: 33-year-old woman with difficulty breathing
arrival: A 33-year-old woman with a history of asthma presents with difficulty breathing for 3 days.
keyCriterion: Yellow — Airway & breathing: wheezing (no red criteria)
feedbackWhy: She has audible wheezing but does not meet any high-risk red criteria.

airway_red.text: Speaks in clear sentences. No accessory muscle use. No central cyanosis.

circulation_red.text: No heavy bleeding. No weak, fast pulse.

disability_red.text: No convulsions. Alert with normal mental status.

other_red.text: No trauma, poisoning, threatened limb or chest pain. Not aggressive.

circulation_yellow.text: No vomiting, diarrhoea, bleeding or fainting. Drinking normally.

disability_yellow.text: Alert and not confused. No weakness. Not in severe pain.

other_yellow.text: No rash, deformity, fracture, dislocation or surgical diagnosis.
